pageCache.pageTitle: Danehill Church of England Primary School - Music Providers
pageCache.text:
Music Providers
At Danehill CE Primary School we have two external music providers who visit us weekly and offer lessons to the children.
Create Music:createmusic.org.uk/apply01273 261565Create Music offer Keyboard/Piano and Violin lessons at our school.
Rock and Pop:www.rockandpopfoundation.com01252 368330Rock and Pop offer Keyboard, Drums and Guitar lessons at our school.
For more information and to book lessons for your child, please contact the music providers directly.

pageCache.pageTitle: Danehill Church of England Primary School - PE and Sports Premium
pageCache.text:
PE and Sports Premium
All schools receive the PE and Sports Premium which they should use to make additional and sustainable improvements to the PE, sport and physical activity they provide.
Read our PE and Sports Premium report to discover how we utilise the funding to ensure equal access to high-quality PE provision for all our children, as well as providing opportunities for them to experience and participate in a diverse range of sports and physical activities.

pageCache.pageTitle: Danehill Church of England Primary School - Breakfast Club
pageCache.text:
Breakfast Club
Our Breakfast Club runs every day of the week from 8:00am and during the session the children receive a choice of cereals and/or toast for their breakfast (see the breakfast menu below for more details). It is supervised by Emma Flower, one of our TAs and it is available for all pupils (for Reception children it is available after October half term). At 8:30am, the children are taken into the playground where they are then supervised by a member of staff.
You can book Breakfast Club sessions in advance via Arbor at a cost of £3.50 per child per day. If you have any issues making a booking, please email the school office at office@danehill.e-sussex.sch.uk.
We would ask if you could please ensure your child arrives on time, so that the club can run smoothly, thank you.
Breakfast includes a choice of:
Toast with preserves and butter.

pageCache.pageTitle: Danehill Church of England Primary School - After School Clubs
pageCache.text:
After School Clubs
We run an after school club from Monday to Friday 3.15-5.30pm term time only. The cost is £9.00 per day and must be booked and paid for in advance via Arbor. You can book a club session on the day up until 2.45pm.Children can attend from Year 1 onwards. Reception can also attend, usually starting after Christmas, but if you do need this service, please contact the school office so a decision can be made together with parents.
Each day, children attending the After School Club will receive a snack and can choose between a range of indoor and outdoor activities. In addition, there will be an “activity of the day” for those who wish to take part. These activities will typically run until 4:15pm, after which children will move into a period of free play.The club is booked as a single session at a cost of £9; however, children may be collected at any time during the session. For collection, please come to the main entrance and use the buzzer. If the children are playing outside, Tiffany may not hear the door, so please call the school mobile on: 07395 852 495.
If you require any assistance with bookings, please contact the school office or speak to Tiffany: office@danehill.e-sussex.sch.uk
After School Club Poster
As well as our After School Club, please see below alternative clubs that are also on offer from external providers:

pageCache.pageTitle: Danehill Church of England Primary School - Children's Forest
pageCache.text:
Children's Forest
The Children's Forest is a journey with children: connecting with nature, imagining the future forest, planting tress in a heart-centred way and tending the forest together into the future. Throughout March, Danehill children planted trees in order to transform a field at Wowo campsite into our children's forest.
Our journey began with a school pilgrimage, when we walked from Danehill to Wowo campsite. We walked through fields and woodland, looking out for mature, healthy trees that could provide seeds for saplings that will become the next generation of trees.
Click below to watch the film documenting some of our tree planting:
https://www.itv.com/news/meridian/2024-03-21/youngsters-gather-to-plant-childrens-forest-in-sussex
Children's Forest
Visit the children's forest website to find out more: https://childrensforest.earth/
